tools.name: search_routes
tools.description: First step for any trip question. Finds Platinumride private transfer routes when the user names cities, countries, airports (e.g. DXB, RUH) or Arabic city names. Full sentences and common typos are fine. Returns matching routes with summary info: slug, travel time, distance, border crossings, indic

tools.name: get_route_details
tools.description: Returns full details for one route. Needs a slug from search_routes. If you do not have a slug, call search_routes first. Returns per-vehicle price tiers (indicative 'from' prices in local currency and approx. AED; the team confirms the final price), travel time and distance, border crossings and ca

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Sends a booking request to the Platinumride team. Use it only after the customer has chosen a route and agreed to the Terms of Service (https://platinumride.com/terms). Do not use it for browsing or quotes; use search_routes and get_route_details for that. Each call sends a new inquiry and is not id

tools.name: list_travel_guides
tools.description: Lists all of Platinumride's published travel guides (currently 13) in one response, with no pagination or filtering. Each entry has a title, cities, route slug and page URL. Pass a guide slug to get that guide's full text, sections and FAQs. Use it for questions about driving time, border documents

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_travel_guides · Private data: search_routes, list_travel_guides · Public sink: create_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_travel_guides · Private data: search_routes, list_travel_guides · Public sink: create_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_routes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
